entities.summary: Tang Shaoyi, also spelled Tong Shao Yi, courtesy name Shaochuan (少川), was a Chinese statesman who briefly served as the first Premier of the Republic of China in 1912. In 1938, while preparing to collaborate with the Japanese during the Second Sino-Japanese War, he was assassinated by the staff of the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics in Shanghai.
